description: Phase 2 — Pages. A JSON page manifest compiles to one complete, crawlable index.html per page under a clean URL. `adx build <page.json>` builds a page; `adx build <dir>` still builds a single component (strict dispatch by input type). Per-page SEO (lang/canonical/title/description/OG/Twitter) and schema-gated page JSON-LD. Depends on FEAT-001 (reuses resolveProps source 'page' + runSetup).
steps: Create src/page/types.ts (PageManifest { page, title, description, lang?, canonical?, schema?, components: PageComponent[] }, PageComponent { use: string, data?: Record<string,unknown> }) and src/page/load.ts exporting loadPage(path) + parsePage(raw, file). Validate per design Phase 2: required page (slug must match /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/), title, description, non-empty components[] each with required string `use` and optional object `data`; optional lang (default 'en'), canonical (default '/' when page is 'index'/'home' else '/<page>/'), schema. All errors line-less `[ADX] <page-file> - <message>` with the exact strings from the Phase 2 error table (Missing required field "<f>", Invalid page slug "<v>" (lowercase, hyphenated), "components" must list at least one component, Invalid JSON, Cannot read page manifest). Export from src/index.ts.

Add a repoRoot/scope-location helper (in src/compile.ts or a new src/codegen/scope-location.ts): repoRoot = nearest ancestor of the build input containing package.json, else the input's own dir; scopeLocation(repoRoot, absDir) = node:path relative(repoRoot, absDir) with separators normalized to '/'. Used by page (and FEAT-003 composed) paths; the single-component M1 path keeps basename(dir).

Create src/page/compile.ts exporting compilePage(pageManifestPath, opts): CompiledPage. Load+validate the page manifest; for each components[i]: resolve `use` to an absolute component dir relative to the page file's own directory (a target that is a .json file or a dir lacking manifest.json -> fatal `[ADX] <page-file> - Component not found: "<use>"`); compile it through the shared single-component path passing data with source 'page' and the repo-relative scopeLocation as the scopeId location; collect body HTML, CSS, glue. Concatenate component bodies in DOM order inside one <main>; union per-component CSS deduped by resolved absolute dir; emit one glue module per DISTINCT component (carrying its INSTANCES array — the per-instance mechanism itself is finished in FEAT-003) plus a tiny page entry importing each component's module.

Add wrapPageDocument(bodies, page) (in src/page/compile.ts) that emits a complete document from the page SEO fields: <html lang="<page.lang>">, per-page <title>/<meta description>/<link rel=canonical href="<canonical>">/OG/Twitter, and schema-gated JSON-LD `{ "@context":"https://schema.org", "@type":<page.schema>, "name":<page.title> }` emitted only when page.schema is present. Keep adx build <dir> on M1's wrapDocument unchanged (single-component SEO stays M1-fixed root canonical / lang en).

In src/cli.ts implement strict 3-step dispatch: (1) positional arg ends in .json -> page build via compilePage, writing <out>/<slug>/index.html (page 'index'/'home' -> root <out>/index.html) plus style.css, glue.js and each used component's <comp>.behavior.js beside the page; (2) else a dir containing manifest.json -> component build (M1 path, unchanged); (3) else fatal `[ADX] <path> - Not a component directory or page manifest`. `--data` applies only to the component path; a page carries its own per-instance data.

Add fixtures/site/ with index.json and about.json page manifests plus the components they use: reuse fixtures/user-card and add a new fixtures/site/site-header component (manifest.json with a default slot, structure.adx, behavior.adx.js with a setup(), style.adx.css using tokens). Supply each instance's required props via the page manifest data.

Add test/page-load.test.ts (validation table for every Phase 2 error) and test/page-compile.test.ts: compile index.json and about.json; assert index.html and about/index.html contain resolved content, the correct per-page title/description/canonical, <html lang>, JSON-LD @type==schema and name==title, and zero '{{'; assert `adx check <page.json>` (via the API) passes when all instance required props are supplied and fails with the child's `[ADX] manifest.json - Missing required prop ...` when one is not (MEDIUM-6).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` tsc-clean and `npm test` green including the new page suites and all prior tests.
Compiling the two-page fixture site produces <out>/index.html and <out>/about/index.html, each a complete document with resolved content, correct per-page SEO metadata, and zero '{{'.
`adx build <dir>` single-component output is byte-identical to its FEAT-001 behavior (dispatch does not regress the component path).
An invalid page slug, a missing required field, an empty components array, and a `use` pointing at a non-component all fail with their exact line-less `[ADX] <page-file> - ...` messages.
Page JSON-LD (when schema present) has @type equal to the page schema and name equal to the page title (not a component name).
findings:
SHIPPED. New modules: src/page/types.ts (PageManifest + PageComponent), src/page/load.ts (loadPage/parsePage — line-less `[ADX] <page-file> - ...` errors; `<page-file>` is the caller-passed path so errors point at the named file; non-object top-level and array both map to Missing required field "page"; empty/non-array components both map to the "components" must list at least one component message; defaults lang='en', canonical '/' for index|home else '/<slug>/'), src/codegen/scope-location.ts (repoRoot walks up for nearest package.json else input dir; scopeLocation = POSIX-normalized relative(repoRoot, absDir)), src/page/compile.ts (compilePage/checkPage/wrapPageDocument). All exported from src/index.ts.

KEY CROSS-FEATURE NOTES FOR FEAT-003 (composition) + FEAT-006 (docs):
- compile.ts was REFACTORED: extracted compileInstance(dir, opts) as the SHARED single-component path returning CompiledInstance { body (UNWRAPPED html), css, glue, hooks, manifest, scopeId, absDir, mergedProps } PLUS ctx. compileComponent now just wraps compileInstance's body via wrapDocument. FEAT-003's emitComponentInstance should build on compileInstance, not re-implement the pipeline.
- CompileOptions gained TWO internal fields: scopeLocation?: string (the exact string handed to scopeId — single-component path still uses basename(dir); page path passes scopeLocation(repoRoot, absDir)) and propSource?: PropSource (defaults 'standalone'; compilePage passes 'page'). FEAT-003 should pass 'composed'.
- escapeHtml and indentBlock are now EXPORTED from compile.ts (reused by wrapPageDocument). wrapDocument (M1 single-component SEO) is UNCHANGED — standalone builds still emit <html lang="en"> + root canonical; single-component scopeId stays basename-based (verified cba1d828 unchanged), so M1 output is byte-identical (acceptance #3). Page user-card uses a DIFFERENT scopeId (repo-relative location) by design.
- Per-instance glue: FEAT-002 emits one glue module per DISTINCT component (deduped by resolved absolute dir) carrying an INSTANCES array (each record: instanceIndex + its merged props) and loops over it, plus a page entry (glue.js) importing each `./<stem>.glue.js`. The INSTANCES array + loop skeleton is in place but the TRUE per-instance root selection/hook ids (data-adx-i, instanceBindingId) are FEAT-003's job — current page glue still selects the shared [data-adx-c] root, so two instances of the SAME component on one page are NOT yet independently hydrated. FEAT-003 must switch the HTML emitter + this page glue to per-instance ids. scope.ts bindingId is still 2-part (${scope}-${n}); instanceBindingId is NOT added yet (FEAT-003).
- CLI dispatch is strict 3-step (cli.ts run()): arg ends in .json -> runPage; else dir with manifest.json -> runComponent (M1, unchanged); else fatal `[ADX] <path> - Not a component directory or page manifest`. --data applies ONLY to runComponent; pages carry per-instance data. runPage writes index/home to <out>/index.html, others to <out>/<slug>/index.html, plus style.css, glue.js, and per distinct component <stem>.glue.js + <stem>.behavior.js beside the page.
- resolveUse: a `use` ending in .json OR a dir lacking manifest.json -> fatal `[ADX] <page-file> - Component not found: "<use>"`.
- Fixtures: fixtures/site/{index.json,about.json} + fixtures/site/site-header (default slot via `<slot .nav-slot />` -> data-adx-slot=""; required prop siteName). user-card reused via `use: "../user-card"`.
- Tests: test/page-load.test.ts (17, full error table) + test/page-compile.test.ts (13). test/helpers.ts gained `siteDir`. 129 tests pass (99 prior + 30 new), tsc + eslint clean. DOCS NOT touched (doc-sync is FEAT-006). Note: plan.md and FEAT-003.json showed as pre-existing uncommitted modifications in the worktree and were left untouched; only FEAT-002's own feature files were committed.
